name: Julietta
source:
"Everyone has a right for happiness. That goes for you too, Mai."

Le Choara's childcare faculty head. It is her duty to find a home for orphaned children. She assists [url=/c87471]Mai[/url] in moving to Le Choara upon the discovery of Sanae having lived there.
